metadata.name: McKeanNeuron
metadata.author: McKean, H.P.
metadata.description: McKean 1970 piecewise-linear FitzHugh-Nagumo caricature — analytically tractable relaxation oscillator whose cubic v-nullcline is replaced by a three-branch piecewise-linear function

dynamics.v: min(max(-v, v - a), 1 - v) - w + I

extensions.piecewise_nullcline_note: The membrane right-hand side uses McKean's three-branch piecewise-linear cubic caricature f(v) = min(max(-v, v - a), 1 - v): the outer branches -v and 1 - v are the stable low and high legs and the middle branch v - a is the unstable threshold leg, joined at v = a/2 and v = (1 + a)/2. This is exact arithmetic (comparisons and linear pieces, no transcendental or cubic term), so the four-stage RK4 flow lowers to fixed point without a look-up table. At the enrolled operating point (epsilon = 0.2, gamma = 0.5, I = 0.6) the system is a sustained relaxation oscillator and each spike is an upward v >= v_peak crossing with no reset.
